scientific_questions.REM: Which predeclared signal, transition, condition and model-output properties accompany REM-to-W/N1/N2 errors relative to correct REM? Associations only.
scientific_questions.explanation: What exact model-behavior information do certificates add when sigma-ranked intervals outperform them on the registered ST spindle proxy?
scientific_questions.strategy: Should the next independent study prioritize model auditing, expert-verified physiology or classifier development?

panels.E1_representative: One scored physical epoch per stage/person/night chosen by lowest SHA256(seed|study|recording|physical_epoch); no model prediction or detector input; maximum 220; missing strata kept
panels.E2_proxy_enriched: All E1 epochs with the existing frozen Pz-Oz spindle-like candidate and assessable detector status; selection independent of explanation support
panels.E3_failure_enriched: At most 40 unique epochs in each of REM_to_W, REM_to_N1, REM_to_N2, correct_REM, correct_N2, non_REM_error; SHA256-ranked with round-robin person/night priority; shortages reported without replacement
panels.overlap_policy: Keep coordinates unique per panel; cross-panel overlap is recorded and shared cached computations are never counted as independent observations

signal_measures.SC_EMG: native_1_Hz_processed_envelope_only; not pooled as equivalent to raw ST EMG
signal_measures.source: frozen Phase XIV caches where identities match; one approved original-ST read pass only for new waveform measures

forensics.warning_threshold_source: fixed numeric protocol constants, not fitted on ST

comparison.new_tables: base and neutral_0.01 only for unique E1/E3 cases not already cached; cached Phase XIV panels reused when exact identities match
comparison.method_access: No method receives scored labels or proxy intervals when selecting atoms; event overlap uses the same proxy intervals afterward
comparison.matching: All ranking methods matched to exact-positive atom count/physical seconds per case; greedy reported at its own length; empty and whole-epoch support separate
comparison.proxy: Phase XIV YASA 0.6.5 Pz-Oz spindle-like default and strict RMS sensitivity; stage-blind continuous-recording detection unchanged

statistics.missing_policy: report no event, empty support, unassessable flat, detector failure, missing stage and unscored separately
statistics.interpretation: association, not cause or deployable prediction
